findings.title: source-equivalence scope string still says HA be247 deployment/test while manifest and harness are 300c6c9
findings.discrepancy: source-equivalence.scope says "with HA be247 deployment/test"; manifest.source.native_harness_commit says 300c6c9 and support commit 0223b24, and acceptance says HA delta 300c6c9. The digest/hash fields are correct; only the descriptive scope is stale.
findings.impact: A reader checking only source-equivalence.json could misidentify the HA harness version. No numeric/source-equivalence claim is false.
findings.correction: Update the descriptive scope to HA 300c6c9/support 0223b24 or label it as the inherited composition descriptor; no rerun needed.

findings.title: manifest worktree_clean_at_manifest=false is not distinguished from the clean run-state claim
findings.discrepancy: manifest records worktree_clean_at_manifest=false (publication bundle generation state), while README/acceptance say the tree was clean before/after the run and report.json has source_worktree_dirty=false. These concern different moments; no false run-clean claim, but the word "clean" is not qualified.
findings.impact: A reader may read manifest=false as contradicting the run-clean statement. No report or source-equivalence field is contradicted.
findings.correction: Label the manifest field as publication-worktree cleanliness and cite the run field source_worktree_dirty=false; no rerun needed.

scope.one_host: Single physical Linux host; lab allow-unfenced profile; production profile rejects this host.
scope.safe_watchdog: Kernel sysfs major/minor+identity validation only; no device open/ioctl; softdog is configuration compatibility, not hardware proof.
scope.rest: Loopback-only Patroni REST; health GETs unauth by design while management 401/404; TLS/SCRAM and server-key permission negatives exercised.
scope.backup: Local unencrypted trusted closure; checksums_verified=true, authenticity_verified=false; not authenticated/tamper-proof/encrypted.
scope.rpo: 0 acknowledged lost only for automatic promotion; restore intentionally loses one post-boundary ACK OID; no zero-RPO DR claim.
scope.unqualified: No cross-host fencing, hardware watchdog/power-loss/rack/zone, HAProxy HA, Kafka HA or Git-volume replication claim. #43/#44 remain OPEN.
scope.history: Old 85 archived pass is a valid checkpoint only; be247 Git-identity and 579 nonexistent Intent.state are failures, not passes. The earlier source-review pending statement is historical; the current report is the actual 300 pass.

review_method: Read-only source/evidence/report/status/hash inspection; no project edits, no Cargo/native test, no network or GitHub mutation.
